scope: Follow-up to the 2026-10-01 audit (docs/security-audit/findings.json, commit f69ddd8, v1.4.0), which was never committed and is added unchanged in this pull request. Covered: the 19 commits and 17 extension/script files changed since f69ddd8 (v1.4.0 -> v1.6.1), re-verification of both 2026-10-01 items, and npm audit.
methodology: ai_sec.md phases 1-8 as a delta round: full diff of manifest, background service worker, content script, extractor, providers, prompt, options and UI files; sink scan (innerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, href/src assignment, eval/Function, fetch, tabs/scripting APIs) on added lines; npm audit with dependency-type check.

architecture.flow:
WEB PAGE -> content script (isolated world: Readability extraction, top bar UI in shadow DOM)
  -> chrome.runtime message -> background service worker (settings, cache, usage)
  -> provider (Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / OpenAI-compatible base URL) with the user's API key
  -> structured JSON verdict -> validator -> content script panel
components: Manifest V3 extension (Chrome >= 116), permissions: storage; content scripts on http/https pages
API key in chrome.storage.local, read only in the service worker and extension pages
Model output validated against a JSON schema before rendering
trust_boundaries: Web page content -> extractor -> model prompt (untrusted article text)
Content script (page-adjacent) <-> service worker (holds the key)

attack_surface.summary: Unchanged structure since 2026-10-01. New in this period: a read-quality gate that skips thin pages before any provider call, a hasApiKey yes/no in FACTIT_UI_PREFS, prompt v2.2 classification rules, removal of full-result console logging.
items: Messages from content scripts: FACTIT_UI_PREFS (language + hasApiKey boolean), analysis request (article document)

executive_summary: No new findings. SEC-SECRETS-001 from 2026-10-01 (API key readable from the content-script context through chrome.storage.local) is fixed: the service worker calls chrome.storage.local.setAccessLevel({accessLevel: 'TRUSTED_CONTEXTS'}) on every start, so content scripts can no longer read the store. The only new data sent to the page context is a boolean (hasApiKey). The full analysis result is no longer written to the page console. SEC-CHAIN-001 (informational: a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint receives the article and key) is unchanged and remains a user-chosen design trade-off. npm audit shows 2 high advisories, both in transitive dev dependencies (jsdom/undici, source-map-js) that are not packaged into the extension.

strengths.title: SEC-SECRETS-001 closed
strengths.evidence: extension/background/service-worker.js:23 chrome.storage.local.setAccessLevel({ accessLevel: "TRUSTED_CONTEXTS" }); manifest minimum_chrome_version 116 supports the API.

strengths.title: Key never crosses into the page world
strengths.evidence: FACTIT_UI_PREFS returns { language, hasApiKey: boolean }; sender checked with isContentScript/isExtensionPage.

strengths.title: Less page-console exposure
strengths.evidence: content-script.js: removed console.log of the full analysis result; summaries only.

strengths.title: No provider call on unread content
strengths.evidence: readQuality() gate returns article_too_short before any request: no tokens spent, no verdict on text never read.

strengths.title: No new HTML sinks
strengths.evidence: Added lines in ui/panel.js, ui/top-bar.js, options/* contain no innerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML/eval; rendering stays DOM/textContent based.

coverage.detail: 17 changed files since f69ddd8; manifest permissions unchanged (storage only).
No accounts; provider auth is the user's key.
Message handlers keep sender checks; 1 handler changed (FACTIT_UI_PREFS), returns no secret.
Key storage access level restricted; no keys in changed files or history since f69ddd8.
Article text reaches only the model prompt; no DOM/eval sinks added.
Changed UI files: no HTML-string sinks.
MV3 default CSP for extension pages; no remote code.
Full result logging removed; article text never logged.
0 production dependencies; dev: jsdom 30.1.0 -> undici (high), source-map-js (high), not shipped. Vendored Readability unchanged.
Prompt v2.2: article treated as content to assess; output schema-validated before display; no tools/agency. SEC-CHAIN-001 (custom endpoint) unchanged, informational.

recommendations.text: Update jsdom (dev) to pull undici >= 8.12.2; run npm audit fix for source-map-js.
Keep the setAccessLevel call covered by a unit test so a refactor of the worker cannot drop it silently.

limitations: Delta round; files unchanged since f69ddd8 were not re-read.
No browser run in this round; Chrome storage access level behaviour taken from the API documentation.
